summary: The exact candidate repairs the candidate-1 unrelated-component-source substitution: all 28 FAQ and 56 component units carry path/SHA tuples, and ROOM-HELP-10 rejects card-069.png as substitute evidence while accepting its restored manifest tuple. Exact per-unit blind citation tuples and PDF render structure checks also work. Two independent blind-integrity defects remain: canonical source-only prompts can carry forbidden downstream paths/fields, and packet-global/duplicate evidence IDs let one unit's evidence and primary source satisfy another unit's comparison.

findings.title: Canonical source-only prompts can carry forbidden downstream paths and fields
findings.contract: Lane A completeness and Lane B blind reviewers may receive only source-only payloads. Canonical bytes must not contain downstream rules/semantic/implementation paths or conclusion fields, and rejection must occur before a source-only prompt is emitted or dispatched.

evidence.detail: The packet and completeness critic are source-only; the blind prompt may not contain downstream rule paths, semantic paths, or conclusion fields.
canonical_prompt_bytes() frames the packet and accepted completeness review verbatim, and the CLI writes those bytes without any downstream-content preflight.

FORBIDDEN_PROMPT_TOKENS is a short fixed list: one semantic-directory prefix, five concise-rule paths, and only four field names. It omits implementation paths and post-reveal fields such as downstreamPath.

Packet validation and canonical byte comparison do not scan source-only free-text. The only token scan is applied to the blind prompt after a completeness review already exists; no equivalent pre-send completeness-prompt gate exists.

The committed controls hand-edit the already-built blind prompt for one listed token and for noncanonical bytes. They do not inject a forbidden path/field through a canonical packet or exercise the completeness prompt.

observed: A schema-valid packet with searchTerms=["docs/rules/semantics/pilots.json"] passed validate_packet with zero failures, and canonical_prompt_bytes(completeness, packet) emitted a prompt containing that downstream semantic path.

A fully canonical packet/completeness/blind chain with searchTerms=["js/engine.js downstreamPath"] passed the candidate validator with passed=true and failureCount=0; the exact canonical blind prompt contained both the implementation path and downstream field name.

findings.impact: A packet author can anchor the source-only completeness critic and blind derivation with implementation or downstream comparison metadata while preserving canonical prompt bytes and all current hashes. A listed token can reach the completeness reviewer before the late blind scan; an unlisted path/field reaches the blind reviewer and validates end to end. This defeats the audit's blindness premise.
minimalFix: Move source-only content validation into a shared preflight invoked by canonical_prompt_bytes() for both completeness and blind modes, so no forbidden prompt can be emitted.

Reject exact downstream repository paths and closed post-reveal field identifiers wherever they occur in free-text values. Derive the path deny-set from locked concise/semantic/implementation roots and artifacts rather than maintaining the current partial tuple; do not use a broad official-language n-gram ban.
Validate the accepted completeness review with the same source-only preflight before including it in a blind prompt.
Add canonical-packet controls for a known semantic path in the completeness prompt and unlisted implementation path/downstreamPath leakage in the blind prompt.

findings.title: Evidence IDs and primary-source reveals are packet-global rather than unit-scoped
findings.contract: Evidence must remain assigned to exact audit units. Evidence IDs must resolve uniquely, comparison/verification evidence references must resolve to evidence assigned to that comparison unit, and a primary-source reveal must be a source tuple present in that unit's sealed packet evidence.

evidence.detail: Evidence rows carry evidenceId and auditUnitIds, but the schema does not make evidenceId unique.
Packet validation correctly enforces unit coverage and manifest-bound FAQ/component source tuples, but it never rejects duplicate evidenceId values.

Blind citations are correctly checked against exact (sourcePath, locator) tuples assigned to the current unit, but the downstream metadata is reduced to a packet-global evidence-ID set and sourcePath-to-hash map.

primary-source accepts any source path appearing anywhere in packet evidence, and discrepancy evidenceRefs need only be a subset of the packet-global ID set; neither check uses the current auditUnitId.
Verification and resolution closure reuse the same packet-global evidence-ID set, so later proof can cite another unit's evidence as well.
Committed tests cover an invented citation tuple and an ID absent from the packet, but not duplicate IDs or an existing evidence ID assigned only to a different unit.

observed: Appending a second, different evidence row with the same evidenceId E1 produced a full-chain candidate validation pass with failureCount=0.

In a valid two-unit packet, RULE:FND-001's comparison cited E2 assigned only to RULE:FND-002 and revealed the FAQ PDF used only by FND-002 as primary-source; the full candidate validator still returned passed=true and failureCount=0.

findings.impact: A comparison, verifier, or final resolution can support one audited unit with unrelated evidence assigned to another unit in the same batch. Duplicate IDs also make an evidence reference non-unique. These defects can turn a source-unsupported comparison into structurally accepted audit evidence despite the correct blind-citation tuple check.
minimalFix: Reject duplicate evidenceId values in every packet before any reviewer prompt is built.
Preserve evidence IDs and source path/SHA tuples as maps keyed by auditUnitId, not packet-global sets/maps.
Require every discrepancy, verification, and resolution evidence reference to resolve uniquely within the current audit unit's assigned evidence.
Require a primary-source revealed artifact's exact path/SHA tuple to occur in evidence assigned to the current comparison unit.
Add full-chain controls for duplicate evidence IDs, cross-unit discrepancy/verification/resolution references, and cross-unit primary-source reveals.

verifiedControls.detail: All 84 FAQ/component units have sourcePath, sourceSha256, and extractionPath. For COMPONENT:room:ROOM-HELP-10, substituting assets/tts-mod/extract/v2-dl/tree/cards/reference/card-069.png@4b0690bf... for the manifest-pinned Rooms Sheet PDF@f97b6838... produced 'lacks manifest-bound source evidence'; restoring the exact tuple produced zero failures.

verifiedControls.control: Manifest-pinned FAQ/component binding and per-unit packet assignment
verifiedControls.detail: The candidate requires at least one evidence row assigned to each packet unit and, for every manifest row carrying sourcePath/sourceSha256, requires an evidence row assigned to that exact unit with the exact tuple. The prelock manifest is current and all 28 FAQ plus 56 component rows are populated.

Every blind requirement, ambiguity, and acceptance-scenario citation must equal an exact packet (sourcePath, locator) tuple assigned to the current unit. The invented-locator negative control passed by rejecting the mutation.

Framed prompt payloads retain exact byte counts and SHA-256 values, and hand-edited prompt bytes are rejected. Finding S7-R07-001 concerns the content admitted into otherwise canonical bytes, not byte reproducibility.

verifiedControls.control: PDF exactText render requirement and PNG structure
verifiedControls.detail: PDF exactText without a rendered visual was rejected. A valid 64x64 PNG passed; corrupt CRC, trailing bytes after IEND, and 16x16 dimensions were all rejected. Same-region quotation/render fidelity remains a source-only completeness-review judgment rather than a mechanical pixel-text proof.

testsRun.result: PASS for expected controls; reproduced both findings with candidate validation passes

This final specialty report outside Git.

issuesEncountered: The first bare-python probe invocation stopped immediately because the system interpreter lacks jsonschema. The probe was rerun successfully with the methodology's pinned uv requirements; no repository artifact was changed by the failed attempt.
residualRisks: A structural PNG check cannot prove that the render depicts the declared PDF locator or that exactText is contiguous and verbatim; the independent source-only completeness reviewer must visually verify the exact region before acceptance.
This is a prelock harness review. All 140 units remain pending, so no claim is made about future packet, derivation, comparison, verification, or adjudication content beyond the reviewed controls.
